points.add.description: Gives a viewer points. A negative amount takes points away. The balance never goes below 0. Leave the user out for the person who triggered the action.

parameters.platform: Optional. The viewer's platform, like "twitch". Leave it out for the platform of the trigger.
parameters.user: Optional. The viewer's name, like "CoolViewer42" (a leading @ is fine). They must have chatted or have points before.
parameters.userId: Optional. The viewer's id on that platform. Leave user and userId out for the person who triggered the action.
parameters.amount: How many points, a whole number like 100. Use a negative number to take points away.
parameters.currency: Optional. Which currency, by name, like "coins". Leave it out for your default currency.

points.awardGroup.description: Gives points to every viewer in a user group (see the Groups page), like a bonus for regulars. Fails when the group does not exist.

parameters.amount: How many points, a whole number like 100.
parameters.applyMultipliers: Optional. true multiplies each viewer's amount by their multiplier. Leave it out for false.
parameters.currency: Optional. Which currency, by name, like "coins". Leave it out for your default currency.

points.currencies.description: Lists your points currencies, like "points" or "coins". The default currency comes first.
points.currencies.returns: A list. Each currency has name, singularName, symbol, variableName and enabled.

points.format.description: Turns a number into nice points text, like "1,250 points", "1 point" or "🍪1,250" when the currency has a symbol.

parameters.amount: How many points, a whole number like 100.
parameters.currency: Optional. Which currency, by name, like "coins". Leave it out for your default currency.

points.get.description: Reads how many points a viewer has. Leave the user out for the person who triggered the action. Fails when the viewer cannot be found.

parameters.platform: Optional. The viewer's platform, like "twitch". Leave it out for the platform of the trigger.
parameters.user: Optional. The viewer's name, like "CoolViewer42" (a leading @ is fine). They must have chatted or have points before.
parameters.userId: Optional. The viewer's id on that platform. Leave user and userId out for the person who triggered the action.
parameters.currency: Optional. Which currency, by name, like "coins". Leave it out for your default currency.

points.leaderboard.description: Gives you the viewers with the most points, highest first. Handy for a !top command.

parameters.platform: Optional. Only viewers of this platform, like "twitch". Leave it out for every platform.
parameters.count: Optional. How many to give back. Leave it out for 10; 0 gives everyone.
parameters.currency: Optional. Which currency, by name, like "coins". Leave it out for your default currency.

points.leaderboard.returns: A list. Each place has Rank, Platform, UserId, UserName and Points.

points.multiplier.description: Tells you how much a viewer's automatic earnings are multiplied, from their role, their groups and their own multiplier.

parameters.platform: Optional. The viewer's platform, like "twitch". Leave it out for the platform of the trigger.
parameters.user: Optional. The viewer's name, like "CoolViewer42" (a leading @ is fine). They must have chatted or have points before.
parameters.userId: Optional. The viewer's id on that platform. Leave user and userId out for the person who triggered the action.
parameters.currency: Optional. Which currency, by name, like "coins". Leave it out for your default currency.

points.remove.description: Takes points from a viewer. The balance never goes below 0. Leave the user out for the person who triggered the action.

parameters.platform: Optional. The viewer's platform, like "twitch". Leave it out for the platform of the trigger.
parameters.user: Optional. The viewer's name, like "CoolViewer42" (a leading @ is fine). They must have chatted or have points before.
parameters.userId: Optional. The viewer's id on that platform. Leave user and userId out for the person who triggered the action.
parameters.amount: How many points, a whole number like 100.
parameters.currency: Optional. Which currency, by name, like "coins". Leave it out for your default currency.

points.set.description: Sets a viewer's points to an exact number. Leave the user out for the person who triggered the action.

parameters.platform: Optional. The viewer's platform, like "twitch". Leave it out for the platform of the trigger.
parameters.user: Optional. The viewer's name, like "CoolViewer42" (a leading @ is fine). They must have chatted or have points before.
parameters.userId: Optional. The viewer's id on that platform. Leave user and userId out for the person who triggered the action.
parameters.amount: How many points, a whole number like 100.
parameters.currency: Optional. Which currency, by name, like "coins". Leave it out for your default currency.

points.setGroupMultiplier.description: Sets a multiplier for everyone in a user group, so they earn more (or less) points automatically.

parameters.multiplier: A number like 1.5 or "2x". Leave it empty (or "none") to remove the multiplier.
parameters.currency: Optional. Which currency, by name, like "coins". Leave it out for your default currency.

points.setGroupMultiplier.returns: true. Fails when the group is empty or the multiplier is not a number.

points.setUserMultiplier.description: Sets one viewer's own multiplier, so they earn more (or less) points automatically. Leave the user out for the person who triggered the action.

parameters.platform: Optional. The viewer's platform, like "twitch". Leave it out for the platform of the trigger.
parameters.user: Optional. The viewer's name, like "CoolViewer42" (a leading @ is fine). They must have chatted or have points before.
parameters.userId: Optional. The viewer's id on that platform. Leave user and userId out for the person who triggered the action.
parameters.multiplier: A number like 1.5 or "2x". Leave it empty (or "none") to remove the multiplier.
parameters.currency: Optional. Which currency, by name, like "coins". Leave it out for your default currency.

points.setUserMultiplier.returns: true. Fails when the viewer cannot be found or the multiplier is not a number.

points.spend.description: Takes points from a viewer only when they have enough, like paying for a reward. Nothing changes when they are short.

parameters.platform: Optional. The viewer's platform, like "twitch". Leave it out for the platform of the trigger.
parameters.user: Optional. The viewer's name, like "CoolViewer42" (a leading @ is fine). They must have chatted or have points before.
parameters.userId: Optional. The viewer's id on that platform. Leave user and userId out for the person who triggered the action.
parameters.amount: How many points, a whole number like 100.
parameters.currency: Optional. Which currency, by name, like "coins". Leave it out for your default currency.

points.spend.returns: true when the points were paid, false when the viewer did not have enough.

points.transfer.description: Moves points from one viewer to another, like a !give command. Fails when the giver has too few points or gives to themselves.

parameters.platform: Optional. The giver's platform, like "twitch". Leave it out for the platform of the trigger.
parameters.user: Optional. The giver's name. Leave user and userId out for the person who triggered the action.
parameters.userId: Optional. The giver's id on that platform.
parameters.to: The name of the viewer who gets the points, like "CoolViewer42". They must have chatted or have points before.
parameters.toUserId: Optional. The receiver's id, instead of the name.
parameters.toPlatform: Optional. The receiver's platform. Leave it out for the giver's platform.
parameters.amount: How many points to give, a whole number above 0, like 100.
parameters.currency: Optional. Which currency, by name, like "coins". Leave it out for your default currency.

points.transfer.returns: An object with from (the giver's new balance) and to (the receiver's new balance).
